terr_bcs.summary_en: State unit of the 2026–2056 programme. Regulatory ceiling via POERBCS and PED; isolated power grid (SIBCS).

terr_los_cabos.summary_en: Highest tourism–residential pressure pole. PDU 2040, OOMSAPAS Cabos and aquifers 0317/0319 in deficit.

terr_la_paz.summary_en: Second demographic pole and political capital. Aquifer 0324 in deficit; PDUCP Population Centre.

terr_loreto.summary_en: North-central pole tied to Bahía de Loreto NP; lower absolute volume but high ANP sensitivity.

terr_comondu.summary_en: Agricultural municipality (Valle Santo Domingo). ITER catalogue + municipal fiscal in 13_territorial_intelligence; no PDU/zoning on disk. Do not invent DMA/energy here.

terr_mulege.summary_en: Largest-area municipality; mining/fishing and Vizcaíno ANP condition corridors. ITER catalogue + fiscal in TI; no PDU on disk. Water–energy capacity not claimed beyond TI.

terr_corredor_cabos.label_en: Cabo San Lucas–San José del Cabo corridor
terr_corredor_cabos.summary_en: Hotel–residential axis concentrating water demand, power peaks and pressure on PDU/POEL.

terr_todos_santos.summary_en: La Paz fringe with PSDU and aquifer 0313 in deficit; tension between boutique tourism and water capacity.

terr_anp_cabo_pulmo.summary_en: Marine core that closes construction/mining/dredging in the Cabos influence zone; CONANP ecological lock.

terr_anp_sierra_laguna.summary_en: Critical recharge for southern aquifers and use veto in the core; ecological–hydrological capacity bridge.

terr_anp_vizcaino.summary_en: Large northern ANP; conditions corridors and works (e.g. Transpeninsular Guerrero Negro–Vizcaíno).

terr_anp_loreto.summary_en: Marine–coastal lock on Loreto growth; CONANP management programme in force.

terr_anp_apff_csl.summary_en: Flora and Fauna Protection Area (~3,996 ha, 1973 decree). Present in CONANP 2025 layer and POER UGA BCS55PT; management-plan text still a gap.

inst_poerbcs.summary_en: Regional Ecological Ordinance decreed (Jan 2026). Sets state UGAs; SEPUIMM is lead. Ceiling over PDU/POEL.

inst_ped.summary_en: Sexennial government agenda; aligns SETUE/SEPUIMM but does not replace the POER ecological ceiling.

inst_pdu_cabos.summary_en: Municipal land-use instrument (IMPLAN). Operates under POERBCS; strained by DMA in deficit.

inst_pdu_lapaz.summary_en: Urban development plan for the capital; must cohere with POERBCS and DMA 0324.

inst_poel_cabos.summary_en: Local ecological ordinance in articulation with IMPLAN/SEPUIMM; municipal bridge of the POER.

inst_ley_aguas.summary_en: State water framework; CEA and municipal operators act under this ceiling together with federal CONAGUA.

inst_prodesen.summary_en: National electricity planning (SENER). For BCS defines scenarios of the isolated system versus the SIN.

inst_pamrnt.summary_en: Grid expansion and modernisation programme; SIBCS transmission/distribution bottlenecks.

inst_veda_1954.label_en: Federal bans 1954 (type III, southern BCS region)
inst_veda_1954.summary_en: DOF 2 and 6 Jul 1954: limited extractions / indefinite ban. Legal layer under which southern aquifers operate together with DMA NOM-011.

rc_acuifero_0317.summary_en: DMA 2024 in severe deficit (~−24 hm³/year). No volume for new concessions; hard lock on the corridor.

rc_acuifero_0319.summary_en: DMA in deficit (~−12.5 hm³/year). Feeds SJD and part of the corridor; direct hotel–residential pressure.

rc_acuifero_0324.summary_en: DMA in deficit (~−13.5 hm³/year). Conditions capital expansion and Todos Santos corridor via regional supply.

rc_acuifero_0313.summary_en: DMA in deficit (~−3 hm³/year). Small in absolute volume but critical for the boutique corridor.

rc_acuifero_0320.summary_en: DMA +0.30 hm³/year (~9.5 l/s) under 1954 ban. CONAGUA names it a 'tourism alternative'; the figure does not licence a pole. CENACE flags electrical pressure in the same zone.

rc_acuifero_0318.summary_en: DMA in deficit (~−2.29 hm³/year). Closes groundwater supply on East Cape together with the park ANP lock.

rc_sibcs.summary_en: Isolated grid outside the SIN. Reference peak 688.5 MW (Sep 2024) on alert; CFE/CENACE ceiling.

rc_aeropuerto_sjd.summary_en: Main tourism-demand gateway. GAP concession ~until 2048; brownfield that conditions seasonal peaks.

rc_aeropuerto_lap.summary_en: Secondary state gateway under GAP concession; relevant for the capital and north–south connectivity.

rc_vivienda_cabos.summary_en: Stock and urbanisation frontier conditioned by PDU, water and energy; proxy for 'how many keys'.

rc_tx_lapaz_cabos.summary_en: Operational limit 237 MW (2×230 kV + 1×115 kV). 2024: 10 h over limit, 603 h >95%. Bottleneck separating La Paz generation from the corridor.

dd_turismo_cabos.summary_en: Dominant driver of water, energy and land in the CSL–SJD corridor. Without a capacity balance there is no keys target.

dd_residencial_cabos.label_en: Los Cabos residential and second homes
dd_residencial_cabos.summary_en: Permanent/semi-permanent demand competing with hotels for DMA and grid capacity.

dd_turismo_lapaz.summary_en: Moderate pressure vs Cabos but sensitive to aquifer 0324 and an ecological-capital narrative.

dd_agro_santo_domingo.summary_en: Historical irrigation demand under DOF bans and regulations; anchored in Comondú (TI/strengths). Do not invent municipal DMA here.

dd_eventos_foro.summary_en: Public convening (Nov) and engagement platform; does not close Stage 1 but accelerates political narrative.

const_escasez_agua.summary_en: Four key aquifers in DMA deficit. Design veto on growth scenarios without new supply (desal/reuse).

const_dma_deficit.summary_en: CONAGUA availabilities with no margin for new concessions at growth poles.

const_red_aislada.summary_en: BCS outside the SIN; peaks on alert. Planning hotels/residential without PAMRNT/PRODESEN is a central risk.

const_anp_nucleos.summary_en: Cabo Pulmo, Vizcaíno, Sierra La Laguna and Loreto close construction/mining/dredging in cores; they are not decorative annexes.

const_tenencia.summary_en: Recurring limit on peri-urban expansion and corridors; appears in PDU mapping (e.g. Los Barriles).

const_ciclo_politico.summary_en: PED 2021–2027 window and municipal calendars condition Commitment, Forum and decree pace.

const_intrusion_marina.summary_en: Levels below mean sea and quality damage from over-extraction. Quality lock in addition to volume deficit in 0324/0323.

actor_sepuimm.summary_en: Lead of POERBCS and state territorial alignment. F+P subgroup: State Level — SEPUIMM.

actor_setues.summary_en: Aligns tourism–economic agenda to the long horizon; bridge with governorship and Forum.

actor_conagua.summary_en: Federal authority on DMA, bans and concessions. Source of truth for the water lock.

actor_cea.summary_en: State water commission; articulates Water Law, WWTP and desalination with municipal operators.

actor_oomsapas_cabos.summary_en: Municipal water/sewer operator at the highest-deficit pole. Key node on capacity→PDU paths. Head (2024–2027 org chart): Ing. Ramón Edgardo Rubio Apodaca.

actor_cfe.summary_en: Operates the SIBCS; concentrates capacity and expansion bottlenecks.

actor_cenace.summary_en: System operator and PAMRNT; defines SIBCS grid expansions.

actor_conanp.summary_en: Administers ANP management programmes; guarantor of the ecological lock.

actor_foro.summary_en: Convening and public launch platform (Nov). Steering: Project Governance.

actor_fp.summary_en: Lead for Territorial Development / Vision & Spatial Framework; methodological custodian of the shadow programme.

actor_gobernador.summary_en: State buy-in and Commitment Agreement signature; political-cycle node.

actor_ayunt_cabos.summary_en: Highest growth permits and pressure in the state; aligns local PDU/POEL.

actor_ayunt_lapaz.summary_en: Second pole; PDUCP and capital narrative. Steering: Political Stakeholders.

actor_ayunt_comondu.summary_en: Municipal government; 2026 Revenue Law documented in TI fiscal. PMD cited on portal (local PDF pending).

actor_ayunt_mulege.summary_en: Municipal government; 2026 Revenue Law and PMD 2024–2027 on disk (TI/plans). Does not claim water–energy unlock.

actor_implan_cabos.summary_en: Technical authority for PDU 2040 and POEL agreement; Municipal Planning Authorities. Head (2024–2027 org chart): Arq. Beatriz González Gilbert.

proj_desal_cabos.summary_en: Documented PPP project (DOF/Proyectos México). Candidate to ease deficit — not to erase the DMA lock.

proj_transpeninsular.summary_en: State road spine; segments (e.g. Guerrero Negro–Vizcaíno) conditioned by ANP and budget.

proj_commitment.summary_en: Public–private agreement targeted by Steering; depends on capacity balances and political window.

proj_p23_bs1.label_en: P23-BS1 La Paz–Los Cabos transmission increase
proj_p23_bs1.summary_en: CFE-Transmission instructed work; feasible date Dec 2028 in PAMRNT. Enables (does not guarantee today) relief of the 237 MW gate.

ev_dma.summary_en: 2023–2024 DMA agreements and updates for 0313/0317/0319/0324 and neighbours. Numerical basis of the water lock.

ev_prodesen.summary_en: SENER/CENACE documents in 03_energy and data lake; SIBCS ceiling and expansion.

ev_poerbcs.summary_en: SEPUIMM reports and 2026 decree in 01_planning; UGAs as regulatory input.

ev_anp_pm.summary_en: Decrees and MPs for Cabo Pulmo, Vizcaíno, Sierra La Laguna, Loreto in 06_environment.

ev_stakeholders.summary_en: Lists and matrices in 09_shadow_programme and Steering/TAG/Forum data-lake packs.

ev_desal_app.label_en: Los Cabos desalination PPP 250 lps factsheet
ev_desal_app.summary_en: DOF call and Proyectos México factsheet; evidence of water-infrastructure readiness.

ev_setue_ie.summary_en: State and municipal profiles (BCS, Los Cabos, La Paz; Loreto 2020). Demographics, tourism, airport — demand driver documented by SETUE.

ev_fiscal_municipal.summary_en: 2026 revenue laws and 2025 Anexo I-33 by municipality (incl. Comondú/Mulegé). Informs fiscal agenda/readiness — does not unlock DMA or SIBCS.

ev_communities_master.summary_en: 2,543 named BCS localities (POBTOT≥1, 2020 Census ITER) in Base de datos BCS 2050 — comunidades. Spatial registry; not a water–energy capacity node.

dq_capacidad_carga.label_en: How much demand fits without breaking water–energy–ANP?
dq_capacidad_carga.summary_en: Mother carrying-capacity question. Must be answered before vision, keys or destination benchmarking.

dq_desal_vs_crecimiento.label_en: Does desalination unlock growth or only sustain the deficit?
dq_desal_vs_crecimiento.summary_en: Distinguishes net new supply vs substitution. Implies SIBCS energy and OOMSAPAS/CEA governance.

dq_agenda_politica.label_en: What is feasible in the current political window?
dq_agenda_politica.summary_en: Crosses Forum (Nov), PED, municipalities and Commitment. Avoids designing off-agenda.

dq_vision_hold.summary_en: Explicit hold until capacity balances; indicative budget ~US$1.5 M does not authorise drawing without locks.

dq_coherencia_instrumentos.summary_en: Regulatory cascade test. Scenarios that redraw UGAs or penetrate ANP cores fall outside instrument.

dq_integridad_ecologica.label_en: Does the scenario regenerate or only mitigate ANP/recharge harm?
dq_integridad_ecologica.summary_en: Ecological-integrity lens; Sierra La Laguna as recharge and cores as veto.

dq_readiness_inversion.label_en: Which infrastructure is ready for investment / PPP?
dq_readiness_inversion.summary_en: Readiness of desal, power grid and airports versus developer narrative.

ev_stills_intel.summary_en: Statewide study: 956 stills with GIS join (~1500 m) to roads, ANP, POER UGA, coast, settlements, waterways and power; AI vision 956/956. Globals: near_coast 169, protected_any 283, in_anp 213, in_osm_protected 20, tourism_resort 45, coast∩protected 72; land_cover desert 535 + scrub 148. Source: Base de datos BCS 2050 — análisis de imágenes del territorio / chat still:overview.

terr_obs_cabos_coast.summary_en: Spatial sample (bbox ~22.8–23.55 N, 110.2–109.4 W): 106 stills. near_coast 23, coast_visible 24, tourism_resort 17, moderate+dense settlement 13, protected_any/in_anp 12. Cover: scrub 32, mixed 23, desert 20. Flags observed hotel–residential pressure on the CSL–SJD fringe — does not invent DMA.

terr_obs_loreto_bay.summary_en: Spatial sample (bbox ~25.5–26.15 N, 111.55–111.15 W): 33 stills. near_coast 15, coast_visible 14, protected_any 16, in_anp 7, tourism_resort 6; desert 16 + scrub 9. Crosses coastal fringe with Bahía de Loreto NP / buffers — high ANP sensitivity at low absolute volume.

terr_obs_vizcaino_spine.summary_en: Northern spatial sample (bbox ~26.5–28.2 N, 115.2–112.5 W): 222 stills. land_cover desert 166 (+ scrub 15), in_anp/protected_any 165, near_coast 35, tourism_resort 3. El Vizcaíno ANP dominates corridors; spatial lock before tourism density.

terr_obs_east_cape.summary_en: East Cape sample (bbox ~23.35–23.9 N, 109.85–109.4 W): 54 stills. near_coast 16, in_anp 7, tourism_resort 10; scrub/mixed/coastal dominant. Coastal tourism ↔ Cabo Pulmo NP interface (+ aquifer 0318 in deficit).

const_coast_anp_pressure.label_en: Coastal tourism pressure at ANP interfaces
const_coast_anp_pressure.summary_en: Of 956 stills: 72 near_coast∩protected_any (Vizcaíno 38, Pacific Islands 6, Bahía de Loreto 5, Cabo Pulmo 2, …); 39 tourism_resort∩near_coast; 20 OSM protected cross-refs. Design lock: observed coastal density hits ANP buffers before 'filling' DMA/SIBCS.

dq_coast_anp_buffers.label_en: Where does coastal tourism pressure meet ANP buffers?
dq_coast_anp_buffers.summary_en: Stills-informed competency Q: map near_coast∩protected fringes (72 points) and East Cape / Loreto / Cabos samples before key-count scenarios on ANP edges.

dq_vizcaino_corridor.label_en: How does Vizcaíno (desert/ANP) condition northern corridors?
dq_vizcaino_corridor.summary_en: Competency Q: 222 stills on Vizcaíno spine with 165 in_anp and desert 166 — any Transpeninsular widening or new node must start from the ANP lock, not tourism density (only 3 tourism_resort in the sample).

dq_stills_densification.label_en: Which coastal fringes show observed densification vs locks?
dq_stills_densification.summary_en: Competency Q: Cabos coastal sample (106) has 17 tourism_resort and 13 moderate+dense settlement vs 12 ANP/protected points; cross with DMA 0317/0319 and SIBCS before licensing more density.

ev_organigrama_cabos.label_en: Los Cabos XV City Council org chart (2024–2027)
ev_organigrama_cabos.summary_en: Transcribed general org chart (99 units, 92 named heads), updated per the Municipal Public Administration Regulation, BOGE #14 of 29 Feb 2024.

actor_cabos_presidencia.summary_en: Head: Arq. Christian Agúndez Gómez (XV City Council 2024–2027). Oversees the General Secretariat, Treasury, Comptroller, Chief Administrative Office, General Directorates, decentralised bodies and delegations.

actor_cabos_dg_ecologia.label_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Ecology and Environment
actor_cabos_dg_ecologia.summary_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Ecology and Environment. Head (2024–2027 org chart): C. Rosa Esther Natali Cruz Ocampo.

actor_cabos_dg_desarrollo_social.label_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Social Development
actor_cabos_dg_desarrollo_social.summary_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Social Development. Head (2024–2027 org chart): C. Carlos Castro Ceseña.

actor_cabos_dg_fomento_economico.label_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Economic Development
actor_cabos_dg_fomento_economico.summary_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Economic Development. Head (2024–2027 org chart): C. Abril I. Urueta Martínez.

actor_cabos_dg_desarrollo_urbano.label_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Urban Development
actor_cabos_dg_desarrollo_urbano.summary_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Urban Development. Head (2024–2027 org chart): C. Roberto Flores Rivera.

actor_cabos_dg_obras_publicas.label_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Public Works and Human Settlements
actor_cabos_dg_obras_publicas.summary_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Public Works and Human Settlements. Head (2024–2027 org chart): C. Alejandra Ramírez Reyes.

actor_cabos_dg_servicios_publicos.label_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Municipal Public Services
actor_cabos_dg_servicios_publicos.summary_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Municipal Public Services. Head (2024–2027 org chart): C. Manuel Ernesto Montaño Castro.

actor_cabos_dg_seguridad_publica.label_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Public Security, Preventive Police and Municipal Transit
actor_cabos_dg_seguridad_publica.summary_en: Los Cabos General Directorate of Public Security, Preventive Police and Municipal Transit. Head (2024–2027 org chart): Cap. de Fragata C.G. Christopher Jordi López Monge.

actor_cabos_delegaciones.summary_en: Delegations of Cabo San Lucas (C. Karina de la O Uribe), Santiago (C. Aracely Cota Ruiz), Miraflores (C. Aremy García García) and La Ribera (C. Linda Maribel Silva Cosío); report to the Mayor's Office.

dq_viabilidad_proyecto.label_en: Is this project viable across coupled factors?
dq_viabilidad_proyecto.summary_en: Viability pack (hotel, desalination, industrial park, housing, road, energy). Families to consult, with no new figures: water (DMA / aquifers / desal), energy (SIBCS / CFE / PRODESEN / PAMRNT), instruments (POERBCS, PDU/PSDU), constraints (ANP, coast, tenure, intrusion), demand drivers (tourism, residential, agriculture), actors and working tables, and gaps marked sin dato en corpus. Does not approve a project: it names trade-offs.

dq_cambio_uso_suelo.label_en: What does the ordinance say about a land-use change?
dq_cambio_uso_suelo.summary_en: Land-use change pack. Consult POERBCS (56 UGAs; policies named in the proposal report: Sustainable Use, Preservation, Protection), urban deferrals in the planning guide (BCS40AS, BCS41AS, BCS32AS, BCS31AS, BCS30AS) and the local PDU/PSDU. Do not invent municipal zoning codes or parcel polygons. If the local instrument is a gap (Cabos PDU 3rd update, La Paz PMDU, Mulegé PDU, Loreto PSDU gazette, DUIS permits), say sin dato en corpus.

dq_riesgos_principales.label_en: What are the main risks for this territory?
dq_riesgos_principales.summary_en: Risk pack. Families: capacity locks (DMA, water scarcity, isolated SIBCS grid), ANP and coastal pressure, tenure, marine intrusion, political cycle, and evidence already in the risks guide (SSN seismicity, state atlas, RAN ejidos). Not a substitute for microzonation. CENAPRED/SSN vector layers for geoprocessing: sin dato en corpus.

dq_oportunidades.summary_en: Opportunity pack. Only what is already encoded: demand drivers, federal or PPP projects on the graph (Cabos desal, La Paz desal, P23-BS1 transmission, CFE combined cycle, housing programme, Pueblos Mágicos), airports as access, Santo Domingo agriculture as Comondú vocation, and the portal's strategic questions. An opportunity does not erase a DMA or SIBCS lock. An industrial park with site and load: sin dato en corpus.

inst_poer_politicas.summary_en: The POERBCS proposal report (SEPUIMM; portal extract) names Sustainable Use, Preservation and Protection policies; the extract cuts off at Protection. The portal's 69-polygon layer (clave_MOE) uses suffixes AS (32), PT (27) and PR (10). RT does not appear in that layer. Full letter-to-name glossary and CODE_PA (2, 3 and 4): sin dato en corpus. Urban deferrals in the planning guide, not parcel zoning: BCS40AS PDU SJC–CSL; BCS41AS PDUCP La Paz; BCS32AS PSDU Todos Santos–El Pescadero–Las Playitas; BCS31AS PSDU Los Barriles–El Cardonal; BCS30AS PSDU Loreto (2007 gazette marked GAP).

ev_mesas_trabajo.summary_en: Tables in Base de datos BCS 2050 — datos del portal (notes 30 Sep 2026): Hospitality; Foreign investment; Transit-oriented development; State politics; Los Cabos urbanisation; Regeneration and biodiversity; Infrastructure and energy (SEPUIMM); Water (CEA and CONAGUA); Architecture and urbanism Los Cabos (IMPLAN); Conservation. Programme tables, not an official org chart or a construction permit.

ev_riesgos_documentados.summary_en: Risks guide: Loreto sequence Apr 2024, peak M5.6 (SSN); swarm south of San José del Cabo (Jul 2024–Oct 2025), 10,340 events, peaks M4.6 and M4.3 (SSN). BCS State Risk Atlas 2024 (state government / UABCS / civil protection) includes fault hazard; POERBCS is not a seismic layer. Ejidos in the RAN KML: 96 (La Paz 31, Mulegé 26, Los Cabos 19, Comondú 18, Loreto 2). CENAPRED/SSN vector layers for geoprocessing: not consolidated.

gap_parque_industrial.summary_en: sin dato en corpus. No industrial park with site, electrical load or water allocation is on the graph or in the packaged federal inventory. Industrial viability can only lean on ceilings already encoded (SIBCS, DMA, POER/PDU) without inventing the park's MW or hm³ demand.

gap_pdu_cabos_3a.summary_en: sin dato en corpus for the third-update decree. Planning guide: 2023 consultation, no final BOGE on disk, not SEPUIMM-validated on the timeline. The 2nd update (council 23 Apr 2013; BOGE No. 19, 6 May 2013) is the one that guide marks as operative.

gap_pmdu_lapaz_texto.label_en: Gap: La Paz PMDU text and parcel zoning
gap_pmdu_lapaz_texto.summary_en: sin dato en corpus for the full PMDU and for secondary or parcel zoning codes. Planning guide: La Paz council approves a PMDU on 20 Dec 2024; full text (~356 pp.) marked GAP (minutes only). PDUCP 2018 is the population-centre plan cited as the latest update on disk. Los Planes PPDU map annexes: wishlist, not verified.

gap_pdu_mulege.summary_en: sin dato en corpus. The planning guide marks a Mulegé PDU as GAP. A 2024–2027 PMD is on disk. Do not invent municipal zoning.

gap_psdu_loreto_gazette.summary_en: sin dato en corpus for the full historical decree. Planning guide: 2024 PSDU update consultation and PMDU on disk; 2007 PSDU gazette and Loreto PMD marked GAP. Cited POER deferral: BCS30AS (Loreto–Nopoló–Notrí–Puerto Escondido–Ligüí–Ensenada Blanca corridor).

gap_permisos_uso_suelo.summary_en: sin dato en corpus. Base de datos BCS 2050 — brechas de datos gap-re-permits-pipeline (open): no inventory of building permits, land-use permits and DUIS by municipality with amounts and typology.

gap_politica_uga_leyenda.summary_en: sin dato en corpus for the full letter-to-policy table and for the meaning of CODE_PA. Observed: AS, PT and PR suffixes on clave_MOE; RT is absent from the 69-polygon layer. Do not assert that RT means Restoration or translate CODE_PA 2/3/4 into a name the extract does not give.

gap_riesgo_capas_vector.summary_en: sin dato en corpus. The risks guide says CENAPRED/SSN vector layers for geoprocessing are not consolidated. Do not invent a seismic, flood or cyclone grid beyond the maps already cited (atlas / gallery).
